name: research_website_shop
description: Shop with a website: reads its own site, saves a dossier where every fact cites a breadbc.gr URL, completes without approval. Runs the real tools against eval fixture rows on dev (search 710670fe 'merc-research eval fixtures'; tool mocks need the FeatureBackofficeEvalTaskFlow flag, which is off).

backoffice_task.expected_behavior: Calls get_candidate with the candidate_id from the task, reads https://breadbc.gr/ with scrape_website (only that site), calls save_dossier exactly once with facts taken from the page (for example sourdough bread and its product categories), each fact with a source_url on breadbc.gr, and finishes the task as completed without asking for approval. It does not invent prices.
